name: Gemini at Georgia Tech
tagline: Hands-on workshops for using Gemini across the tools you already live in.
mission: We're a campus club run by Georgia Tech's Google Student Ambassadors. We host hands-on workshops and events that show students how to use Gemini, NotebookLM, and Gemini's integrations across Google Workspace for real student work: studying, research, projects, clubs, and recruiting.
membership: Membership is free and open to every Georgia Tech student, whatever your major or year. You don't need any coding experience, just a laptop and a Google account. Join the mailing list to hear about events.

integrations.useCase: Summarize a 40-email group-project thread and draft a reply that assigns next steps.
Turn messy lab notes into a structured report outline, then tighten the prose.
Build a club budget tracker and ask for formulas in plain English.
Generate a first-draft pitch deck and on-brand images for a hackathon demo.
Ask questions across every file in a project folder without opening any of them.
Plan an exam week around classes, meetings, and study blocks.
Get auto-generated notes and action items from team meetings.
Load lecture slides and readings, then generate study guides, quizzes, and Audio Overviews.
Prototype an app with the Gemini API in an afternoon, no setup required.
Get code explained, debugged, and extended inside your data-science notebooks.

events.title: Kickoff: Gemini 101
events.description: A tour of the Gemini app, Gems, Deep Research, and Canvas, plus free pizza. Bring a laptop.

events.title: Study Smarter with NotebookLM
events.description: Turn your course materials into study guides, flashcards, and podcast-style Audio Overviews just in time for midterms.

events.title: Gemini in Workspace: Run Your Club on Autopilot
events.description: Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar workflows for club officers and project teams.

events.title: Build Night: Ship a Gemini App
events.description: Go from idea to a working prototype with Google AI Studio and the Gemini API. Mentors on hand, prizes for best demos.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: Nope. Most workshops use Gemini inside Google apps you already use. Build nights are the only coding-focused events, and beginners are welcome there too.
A laptop and a Google account. A personal Gmail works; some features need a Google AI Pro plan, and we'll show you how to get the free student offer if one is available.
Nothing. Membership and every event are free.
About every two weeks during the semester. Check the Events section for exact dates.

faq.q: Can my org partner with you?
faq.a: Yes! We love running custom workshops for other clubs, classes, and teams. Email us.
